notes: POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity can meet 100 rps burst, 20 rps steady for multi-tenant agent workload with p95 < 300ms for single-turn chat and < 200ms for reranking batch size 8.
Representative workloads: chat support (avg prompt 120 tokens + 80 tokens response), reranking pipeline (8 candidates, ~30 tokens each), nightly batch embeddings (500k docs/week).
Throughput targets: sustained 20 rps steady-state, 100 rps burst for short windows (1-5 min). Latency SLOs: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms for chat; rerank latency p95 <200ms at batch size 8.
GPU planning: preference for H100 for reranking-heavy flows but cost team pushing A100v4. Need Redwood to provide per-GPU throughput profile and recommended pool sizing (8, 16, 32 GPUs scenarios).

Load test plan executed: staged ramp (1->10->25->50->100 rps), 2h holds at each step. Observed tail latency increases at sustained 50 rps due to KV cache thrash; SE recommends increasing KV cache capacity + warmup policy.

Soak tests: 24h sustained 20 rps, warmup/washout in first 3h. Memory leak suspected in custom preprocessor (customer side) not Redwood runtime. Redwood asked to run 48h controlled soak with isolated runtime to confirm.

Routing/fallback requirements: must support automatic fallback to smaller quantized model under heavy load with deterministic degradations. Customer asked for a policy that favors latency SLO over quality when configured.

Security: require SSO/SAML setup, HSM/KMS for key wrap, audit logs forwarded to SIEM, and 7-year retention for audit records for regulated contracts. Data residency: EU for EU customers, but primary HQ NA.

SLA negotiation points: uptime % SLA for dedicated pool, definition of burst capacity, mean time to scale (minutes), and credits for p95 misses. Procurement asks for explicit MTTB (mean time to begin) for failover to backup region.
Quote ask: reserved 8-GPU pool with optional burst to 16 GPUs (30% monthly cap), include detailed perf appendix and soak results. Procurement wants a 12-month commit + annual true-up.
Customer quote: 'We need predictable tail behavior — p95 is our main risk metric. If you can show consistent p95 across 48h soak, we move to procurement.'
